variables.label: GAIA2 runtime policy
variables.description: Bounded event, recovery, write, A2A, and observation-noise policy; never contains evaluator truth.

variables.label: GAIA2 correction policy
variables.description: Answer-blind correction limits. Correction replays use a clean session and never add pass@5 attempts.

variables.label: GAIA2 scenario state
variables.description: Safe scenario identity and agent-visible capability metadata for the current session.

variables.label: GAIA2 virtual clock state
variables.description: Checkpointable virtual time and pending waits; wall-clock sleeps are not task truth.

variables.label: GAIA2 event state
variables.description: Consumed and pending event occurrences with dependency and deduplication metadata.

variables.label: GAIA2 attempt state
variables.description: Current attempt identity and lifecycle. Experiment-level pass@5 state is kept outside Prompt Variables.

variables.label: GAIA2 write state
variables.description: Mutation-key and read-back state; unknown non-idempotent writes are never replayed automatically.

variables.label: GAIA2 replan state
variables.description: Parent/child plan lineage and invalidated steps after environment changes.

variables.label: GAIA2 observation state
variables.description: Append-only information-noise ledger summary. Raw observations stay in artifacts; this is a bounded prompt view.

variables.label: GAIA2 information-noise state
variables.description: Profile, independent seed, injection decisions, deduplicated records, conflicts, quarantined results, and schedule hash.

variables.label: GAIA2 observable progress
variables.description: Finite repeated-result and blocked-action counter. A recovery recommendation never claims official completion.

variables.label: GAIA2 runtime context
variables.description: Bounded, answer-blind runtime summary injected into the actor Loop.
